dedupe_keys.name: consistently computed ground motion intensity measures for liquefaction triggering assessment

description: Consistently computed ground motion intensity measures for liquefaction triggering assessment is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Scott Brandenberg, University of California Los Angeles (ucla.edu). The state of practice for assessing soil liquefaction relies on manifestation models developed from databases of liquefaction field case histories. A key component of these case histories is the seismic demand that led to soil liquefaction triggering or lack thereof. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 4 top-level files. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-6vj1-t096. Keywords: ground motion intensity measures, peak ground acceleration, spatial correlation, liquefaction, Next Generation Liquefaction (NGL). Published 2023-10-16. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
